map.根据超声下绒毛膜板、胎盘实质与基底板表现，自动判定 Grannum 分级及临床意: Automatically determine Grannum grade and clinical meaning from ultrasound chorionic plate, parenchyma and basal plate.
map.轻度波浪状，未达基底层: Slightly wavy, not reaching basal layer
map.明显切迹，未达基底层: Marked indentations, not reaching basal layer
map.切迹深达基底层，形成胎盘小叶: Indentations deep to basal layer, forming placental lobules
map.逗点状强回声，近基底层: Comma-shaped bright echoes, near basal layer
map.广泛钙化环，中心透声区: Extensive calcification ring, central anechoic zone
map.💡 Grannum 分级从 0 级（未成熟）到 III 级（成熟/老化），需结合: 💡 Grannum grading runs from 0 (immature) to III (mature/aged); assess placental function with gestational age.
map.III 级胎盘在 37 周前出现可能提示胎盘早熟，需加强监护。: Grade III before 37 wks may suggest premature placental aging; intensify monitoring.
map.胎盘成熟度与胎盘功能不完全等同，应结合胎动、羊水量、胎儿生长等综合判断。: Placental maturity is not identical to function; judge with fetal movement, amniotic fluid, fetal growth, etc.
map.📚 深度解析：胎盘成熟度 Grannum 分级（孕周关联）: 📚 In-Depth: Placental Maturity Grannum Grading (Gestational-Age Link)
map.按孕周解读胎盘分级是否过早成熟。: Interpret by gestational age whether grading is prematurely mature.
map.识别胎盘早熟与胎儿生长受限关联。: Identify the link between premature grading and fetal growth restriction.
map.孕 32 周出现 III 级胎盘：足月前 III 级提示胎盘早熟，需结合 AFI: Grade III at 32 wks: III before term suggests premature aging; combine AFI, umbilical flow and FHR.
map.孕 39 周为 III 级：与胎龄相符的正常成熟，若无其他异常可待自然临产。: Grade III at 39 wks: normal maturation matching fetal age; if no other abnormality, await spontaneous labor.
map.孕周与分级怎么对应？: How do gestational age and grade correspond?
map.大致 0 级 <28 周、I 级 29–36 周、II 级 33–40 周、II: Roughly grade 0 <28 wks, I 29-36 wks, II 33-40 wks, III >=37 wks; higher grade before its week range is premature.
map.分级异常要查什么？: What to check for abnormal grading?
map.查羊水指数、脐动脉 S/D、胎儿生长曲线与胎心监护，综合判断胎盘功能而非单看分级: Check AFI, umbilical S/D, fetal growth curve and CTG; judge function comprehensively, not grade alone.
map.Grannum 分级通过超声观察绒毛膜板、胎盘实质和基底板的形态特征，将胎盘成熟: Grannum grading observes the chorionic plate, parenchyma and basal plate on ultrasound to classify placental maturity 0 to III.
